description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Poison 2 with Stacking] to the user if entry damage was Wind/Poison, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Marcus (Wind, Poison)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Marcus (Wind, Poison)
description.text: Increases [Wind/Poison Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Wind or Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Marcus (Wind, Poison) after using two Wind or Poison abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Tantalus Break+
description.text: Five single attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Marcus (Wind, Poison)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Wind 10% (5s)] and [Imperil Poison 10% (5s)], grants [Buff Wind 10% (5s)] and [Buff Poison 10% (5s)] to all allies

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Poison 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
